name: rust-coding-standards
description: Apply Zevarix Rust Coding Standards when developing or reviewing Rust: focus on correctness, meaningful testing, performance, safety and maintainability.

interface.longDescription: Practical Rust coding and review guidance for human developers and AI coding agents. Find the RCS standards that apply to a project, review changes against their behavioral contracts, and investigate performance bottlenecks with comparable measurements. Includes the existing rcs-guidance and rust-performance skills, which resolve the current canonical rulebook at the consuming project's selected revision. No remote MCP service, account authentication, write permissions or production operations are bundled.
defaultPrompt: Review this Rust change using applicable RCS rules and report evidence-backed findings.
Investigate this slow Rust operation using the RCS performance workflow.
Help me adopt RCS in a Rust project while preserving its existing requirements.

prompts: Review this Rust change against applicable RCS rules, citing the inspected source revision and concrete findings.
Investigate a slow Rust batch operation, checking for redundant I/O and preserving safety boundaries.
Help me adopt Rust Coding Standards in an existing project without overriding its current requirements.

publication.release_notes: Initial public RCS plugin candidate with canonical Rust standards guidance and performance investigation workflows. Includes the two existing RCS skills and an openly licensed PNG Forge crab icon.
